name: app-6a9faeedd4148191b4c78669dfc21ab0
description: Research shareholder-activism campaigns, arguments, tactics, and outcomes with DEF 14.

interface.longDescription: The DEF 14 plugin connects ChatGPT to DEF 14’s shareholder activism intelligence platform. It enables users to research historical activist campaigns, arguments, tactics, and outcomes using DEF 14’s proprietary dataset of structured and unstructured activism materials. Users can identify relevant precedents, compare how activist investors have framed specific arguments, and surface campaign context for use in research and analysis. DEF 14’s underlying data has been processed, cleaned, enriched, and converted into structured metadata to support targeted retrieval. All tools are read-only and operate within the authenticated user’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show Starboard Value’s recent campaigns and outcomes with supporting sources.
Compare how Elliott and Icahn framed board or strategic demands in past campaigns.
What arguments did Elliott make in its Crown Castle presentation? Cite supporting evidence.

review.commerce_description: No purchases are made in ChatGPT. DEF 14 subscriptions are purchased directly from DEF 14.

publication.release_notes: Updates the listing copy, adds light and dark branding assets, and clarifies DEF 14’s shareholder activism research, read-only tools, and entitlement-based access.
